cues.en: We have millions or thousands of computers available at our disposal.
cues.zh: 有數百萬或數千台電腦可用。

cues.en: However, the con of this is that the cost can get out of hand if you don't enforce proper scaling limits.
cues.zh: 不過，缺點是如果沒有設定適當的擴充上限，成本可能失控。

cues.en: So for example, if your app suddenly goes viral and it uses 1000 computers on the cloud, that all costs $10 an hour.
cues.zh: 例如，你的 app 突然爆紅，用了 1,000 台雲端電腦，每台每小時都要 10 美元。

cues.en: That's going to cost quite a bit if you go to sleep and wake up and find that your app has broken the Internet.
cues.zh: 如果睡醒才發現 app 已經紅遍網路，那費用可不少。

cues.en: Another pro of deploying to the cloud is that you can deploy one model and use everywhere.
cues.zh: 雲端部署的另一個優點，是部署一個模型，就能在各處使用。

cues.en: So this is via an API.
cues.zh: 這是透過 API 達成的。

cues.en: So this is counter to the device specific skills.
cues.zh: 這與裝置端需要特定裝置相關技能的情況不同。

cues.en: So if you deploy your model as an API, API stands for application programming interface.
cues.zh: 你可以把模型部署成 API；API 代表 Application Programming Interface，應用程式介面。

cues.en: So if we go what is an API?
cues.zh: 如果搜尋什麼是 API，

cues.en: This is another very common way that you'll see software in general deployed as well as machine learning models.
cues.zh: 這不只是機器學習模型，也是一種很常見的一般軟體部署方式。

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 找到了。

cues.en: And application programming interface is a way for two or more computer programs to communicate with each other.
cues.zh: 應用程式介面是一種讓兩個或更多電腦程式互相溝通的方式。

cues.en: So remember how we said that deploying a machine learning model is your model interacting with someone else or another program.
cues.zh: 還記得，我們說部署機器學習模型，就是讓其他人或另一個程式與你的模型互動。

cues.en: So what you could do with an API is deploy your model as an API and then write another program that goes, Hey, API, here's some data.
cues.zh: 所以，可以把模型部署成 API，再寫另一個程式說：「嘿，API，這裡有一些資料。」

cues.en: Can you give me back a prediction?
cues.zh: 「可以回傳預測結果嗎？」

cues.en: And then you can write that app and use it everywhere.
cues.zh: 接著你就能撰寫那個 app，並在各處使用。

cues.en: Another con here is that predictions can be slower due to data having to leave the device and predictions having to come back.
cues.zh: 另一個缺點是，資料必須離開裝置，預測結果也要傳回來，因此預測可能較慢。

cues.en: So just like we said, hey, API, here's some data.
cues.zh: 就像剛才說：「嘿，API，這裡有一些資料。」

cues.en: Can you send me back a prediction?
cues.zh: 「可以回傳預測嗎？」

cues.en: We have that network latency, meaning we have to upload data and get it back.
cues.zh: 這會產生網路延遲，也就是要上傳資料，再接收結果。

cues.en: And then finally, another part of the cloud is if a lot of modern computing workflows have an existing cloud ecosystem.
cues.zh: 最後，許多現代運算工作流程已經有現成的雲端生態系統。

cues.en: So that's a pro if you're deploying to the cloud, is that it can link into the existing cloud services that your company or app may have.
cues.zh: 因此，部署到雲端的一個優點，是可以整合公司或 app 現有的雲端服務。

cues.en: Cons data has to leave the device.
cues.zh: 缺點則是資料必須離開裝置。

cues.en: So because the compute is not happening on the actual device, the data has to go somewhere else and this may cause privacy concerns.
cues.zh: 因為運算不在實際裝置上發生，資料必須傳到其他地方，這可能帶來隱私疑慮。

cues.zh: 接下來到哪裡了？
